facts.text: Snow left Mt. Howard (7,840 ft) and Aneroid Lake #2 (7,430 ft) 20 to 24 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Mt. Howard
evidence.detail: left May 8; earlier seasons: June 1 (2023), June 6 (2024), May 29 (2025)

evidence.name: Aneroid Lake #2
evidence.detail: left May 28; earlier seasons: June 15 (2023), June 21 (2024), June 17 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Mt. Howard (7,840 ft) and Aneroid Lake #2 (7,430 ft).

evidence.name: Mt. Howard
evidence.detail: 8.9 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 21.1 in (2023), 17.3 in (2024), 17.7 in (2025)

evidence.name: Aneroid Lake #2
evidence.detail: 13.0 in on April 28; earlier seasons: 27.4 in (2023), 20.0 in (2024), 22.3 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 28 and May 28, carried from the melt-out dates at Mt. Howard (7,840 ft) and Aneroid Lake #2 (7,430 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Mt. Howard
evidence.detail: melted out May 8, 1,377 ft above the pass; points to March 13 to May 16

evidence.name: Aneroid Lake #2
evidence.detail: melted out May 28, 967 ft above the pass; points to April 12 to June 9
